description.html: Dubia roaches (Blaptica dubia), small size (S), pack of 100 pieces. Dubia roaches are one of the best live food options for reptiles - they are high in protein (about 22%), low in fat (about 7%) and have an excellent calcium-to-phosphorus ratio. This small size is ideal for juveniles and smaller reptile species such as young leopard geckos, small chameleons, day geckos and frogs.

Unlike superworms, dubia roaches have a softer exoskeleton that is easier to digest. They do not climb smooth surfaces and do not produce an unpleasant smell, which makes them practical to keep at home. Keep them at room temperature with access to food (fruit, vegetables) for gut-loading before feeding your pets.
